Galette 1.3.3 is out of the oven! 🥧

A small batch, but don't let it get cold: upgrading is recommended.

🔒 Three security fixes
👶 Child members can be stored again
🔎 PostgreSQL searches with accented capitals fixed
🐛 And a handful of other fixes
🧩 Activities 1.2.1 and Events 2.3.1 plugins are out too
